name: Faena Hotel Miami Beach
positioning: Faena Miami Beach: a Collins Avenue hotel with South American live-fire dining, its own theater, late-night jazz and a 22,000-square-foot wellness house
best_for: Travelers who want nightlife, live music and theater without leaving the hotel
Food lovers drawn to live-fire asado and contemporary Asian cooking
Guests who want a large wellness space with daily yoga and meditation

facts.text: Faena Hotel Miami Beach is at 3201 Collins Avenue in Miami Beach.
Pao by Paul Qui fuses Filipino, Spanish, Japanese and French flavors into contemporary Asian cuisine.
The Living Room is a late-night jazz bar in a golden-age glamour style.
The Living Room has live music from local artists, bands and DJs.
Tree of Life and Sun Bar is a secluded garden setting with cocktails plus lunch and dinner options.
Every Sunday, Los Fuegos holds a Sunday Asado of gaucho open-fire grilling.
Saxony Bar has live late-night performances and craft cocktails each week.
Daily yoga and meditation are held at Tierra Santa Studio.
The wellness offering includes a Rossano Ferretti salon.
Bay View Rooms look over the Intracoastal Waterway, Biscayne Bay and downtown.
The Partial Ocean View room is in classic South Beach style with late-Deco flair.
Faena Art is a nonprofit showcasing contemporary creative and cultural experiences.

highlights.text: Los Fuegos by Francis Mallmann celebrates South American live-fire cooking with an asado experience.
Obsession at Faena Theater has performances every Thursday, Friday and Saturday.
Tierra Santa Healing House is a 22,000-square-foot wellness space on the hotel's third floor.
Faena came to Miami Beach and transformed an overlooked area into a cultural district.
Hotel guests can explore Miami Beach in Faena's house car, available first-come, first-served.

considerations.text: A resort fee applies; it includes access to the Tierra Santa Healing House wet spa and chaise lounge, umbrella and towel service at the pool and beach.
Professional photography and filming are not allowed in public areas unless approved in advance.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the premium positioning.
